```{r, import}
#| include: false
# import layers

## river extent
exploits_drainage <- vect("data/spatial data/exploits_watershed.shp") |>  
    project("EPSG:4326 - WGS 84")
  
## all rivers
exploits_river <- vect("data/spatial data/exploits_river_field_data.shp") |>  
  project("EPSG:4326 - WGS 84")
  
## lakes
lakes <- vect("data/spatial data/Exploits_lakes.shp") |>  
  project("EPSG:4326 - WGS 84")
  
## data from river reaches sampled
field_reaches <- vect("data/spatial data/exploits_reaches_with_sites.shp") |>  # to be updated with 2025 sites
  project("EPSG:4326 - WGS 84")
  
## shape of NL
NL <- vect("data/spatial data/NL_boundaries.shp") |>  
  project("EPSG:4326 - WGS 84")  

## areas blocked by CABD 
file_barriers <- paste0("data/spatial data/exploits_barriers.shp")
barriers <- vect(file_barriers)

file_inaccess <- paste0("data/spatial data/exploits_inaccess.shp")
inaccess <- vect(file_inaccess)
   
# import arrow
arrow <- "https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2013/07/12/17/54/arrow-152596_960_720.png"
```

```{r, basemap}
#| include: false

# base map gets specific layers added in each tab to it to make unique maps but with same base

exploits_map <- leaflet(width = "100vw", height = "72vh", options = leafletOptions(zoomSnap = 0.25)) |> 
  addProviderTiles('Esri.WorldImagery', group = "Satellite") |> # add base map options
  addProviderTiles('Esri.WorldTopoMap', group = "Topographic") |> # adds base map
  addProviderTiles('Esri.WorldGrayCanvas', group = "White & Grey") |> 

# open map to this screen
  setView(-56.65499, 48.70449, zoom = 8.5) |> 
  
#can recenter to that location by clicking button
  addHomeButton(ext = c(-58.2,48.1, -55.45,49.3), position = "topleft", group = "Recenter") |> 

# create layers to add vectors to
  addMapPane("NL", zIndex = 400) |> 
  addMapPane("drainage", zIndex = 410) |> 
  addMapPane("river", zIndex = 415) |> 
  addMapPane("lakes", zIndex = 420) |>
  addMapPane("inaccess", zIndex = 455) |> 
  addMapPane("barriers", zIndex = 460) |>   
      
  # addPolygons(data = NL, color = "#A1929B", weight = 1.5, fillColor = "#A1929B", fillOpacity = 0.25, options = pathOptions(pane = "NL")) |>
      
# add polygons and lines
## exploits drainage area
  addPolygons(data = exploits_drainage, color = "#32B1DB", weight = 1.25, fillColor = "#236D9E", opacity = 0.4, fillOpacity = 0.2, options = pathOptions(pane = "drainage")) |>
  
## rivers of the exploits
  addPolylines(data = exploits_river, color = "#588BAD", weight = 1.5, options = pathOptions(pane = "river"), group = "exploits", opacity = 0.8) |>
  
## lakes of the exploits
  addPolygons(data = lakes, color = "#234667", stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.9, options = pathOptions(pane = "lakes"), group = "exploits") |>
  
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft") |> 
  addLogo(arrow, position = "bottomleft")



```




### Water chemistry

Describe data here...   
  
Click on a reach to see the data for each segment. Link to download shapefile is [below map](#bottom4).   

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

chem <- read.xlsx("/Users/emmersonEmmerson/Documents/Master\'s/Water_Quality_data_explore.xlsx", sheet = "Data") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  mutate(x = as.numeric(x)*-1) |> 
  mutate(year_trib = paste0(year, "-", trib_size)) |> 
  group_by(year, site_code, trib_size, year_trib, x, y) |> 
  summarise(across(.cols = c(p_h, ec, dissolved_solids_ppm, alkalinity_ppm, doc, tdn, tdn_100), .fns = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>
  ungroup()
  
chem$year <- as.factor(chem$year)
chem$trib_size <- as.factor(chem$trib_size)
chem$year_trib <- as.factor(chem$year_trib)
chem$y <- as.numeric(chem$y)
chem$x <- as.numeric(chem$x)

sdchem <- SharedData$new(chem, group = "myGroup")

ojs_define(chem_data = chem)
```

```{r, palettes_chem}
#| include: false

pal.ph <- colorNumeric(palette = "inferno", domain = chem$p_h)

pal.ec <- colorNumeric(palette = "inferno", domain = chem$ec)

pal.ds <- colorNumeric(palette = "inferno", domain = chem$dissolved_solids_ppm)

pal.ak <- colorNumeric(palette = "inferno", domain = chem$alkalinity_ppm)

pal.dc <- colorNumeric(palette = "inferno", domain = chem$doc)

pal.dn <- colorNumeric(palette = "inferno", domain = chem$tdn)
```



```{r, icons}

icon_ph <- awesomeIcons(
  icon = c("circle", bs_icon("suit-diamond-fill"), bs_icon("square-fill"))[match(chem$year_trib, c("2024-Bg", "2024-Sm", "2025-Sm"))], # Map factor levels to icon names

  iconColor = pal.ph(chem$p_h))

    library = 'fa'

    icon = bs_icon("suit-diamond-fill")
  ),
  "2025-Sm" = makeAwesomeIcon(

  )
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| panel: fill
// Access the shared data directly in OJS
selectedData = crosstalk.filter("myGroup")

viewof selectedLayerGroup = {
  // 1. Create a container for the entire viewof component
  let container = document.createElement("div");
  
  // 2. Create the fixed label and the dynamic display area
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div style="font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px;">Map layer as X Axis:</div>
    <div id="selection-display">p_h</div>
  `;
  
  // 3. Define which element actually holds the value for Observable
  const displayArea = container.querySelector("#selection-display");
  container.value = "p_h";

  // 4. Listen for the custom event
  window.addEventListener("leafletLayerSelected", (e) => {
    // Update only the dynamic area
    displayArea.innerHTML = e.detail;
    
    // Update the value property of the container
    container.value = e.detail;
    
    // Dispatch input event to update Observable
    container.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  });

  return container;
}


viewof yVariable = Inputs.select(["p_h", "ec", "dissolved_solids_ppm", "alkalinity_ppm", "doc", "tdn"], {value: "ec", label: html`<b>Select Y Axis:</b>`})


viewof myPlot = Plot.plot({
    grid: true,
    color: {scheme: "inferno",
      legend: false},
    symbol: {legend: true, 
    range: ["circle", "diamond", "square"]
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.dot(selectedData, {
        x: selectedLayerGroup, 
        y: yVariable,
        fill: selectedLayerGroup,
        symbol: "year_trib"})
    ]
  })

data = transpose(chem_data)
```
